# i18n-dynamic-translate

> Auto-translate missing i18next and i18n-node keys at runtime with DeepL or LibreTranslate. When the app asks for a key that is not in the locale file, the library hooks the missing-key handler, translates the text, adds it to the live i18n instance and writes it to the locale file. Server-side Node.js (>= 22.12) only, zero runtime dependencies, TypeScript declarations included.

Use it for keys that are not known at build time (API metadata, product attributes, category trees). For keys that are already listed in a locale file, a build-time translation CLI is the better fit.

Key facts:

- Entry point: `import { AutoTranslate, Backend, TranslationProvider } from 'i18n-dynamic-translate'`
- Backends: `Backend.I18NEXT` (i18next >= 23, needs `saveMissing: true`) and `Backend.I18N_NODE` (the `i18n` package)
- Providers: `TranslationProvider.DEEPL` (API key) and `TranslationProvider.LIBRE_TRANSLATE` (self-hosted, `apiUrl`)
- Keep the provider API key on the server; the library is not meant for browsers or edge runtimes
